entries.german: Die Brüder Thomas und Hans von Rosenberg sagen dem Eb von Salzburg auf.
entries.english: The brothers Thomas von Rosenberg and Hans von Rosenberg declare war on Eb, Archbishop of Salzburg.

facts.content: sent a declaration of hostility to the Archbishop of Salzburg together with his brother.
